inkRules.summary: Every text, rule and edge takes an ink role. Any role may be used on any surface if it passes contrast: 4.5:1 for text under 18 pt (or 14 pt bold), 3:1 for large text and non-text marks. Failing combinations render with a warning.
inkRules.colorCoding: Rules, edges and swatches may use series.1–9 for color-coding when a text label carries the same meaning.

highlight.note: Extends the Brand Compass (White only) to the lighter gray surfaces. The highlight sits inline and may wrap across lines; each line fragment gets its own mark.

variants.auto: Each new highlight in a deck takes the next shape (1→2→3→4→1), so no two neighboring slides repeat a shape. A fixed shape can be set per use.

rules: Square corners always. No shadows.
Minimum span 3 columns (198 pt). Use pad sm (12) at 3 columns, md (18) at 4 or more.
Body text never smaller than body (14/21); small (12/18) only for sources, roles and footers.
A title is followed by 12 pt before the body (6 pt gap plus 6 pt title spacing); numbers never sit on a line of their own.
An edge sits inside the card bounds. Content padding is measured from the edge's inner side.
A title band takes the inks of its own surface; the body takes the inks of the card surface.
A badge overhangs one corner by half its size and must not cover another card or the slide margin.
Cards in one row share surface, padding, edge, title ink and icon layout. Vary content, not chrome.
A badge never shares a corner with an accent edge; it takes the opposite corner.
bodySize: "small" sets the card body (paragraphs, bullets, checklists, columns) to 12/18 for dense compositions; titles keep their style.

Connectors are geometric (1 pt, elbows allowed); hand-drawn arrows only for annotation.
